source: Barrios and comunas of Medellín: Centro Nacional de Memoria Histórica (CNMH), 'Medellinguerraurbana' feature service layers 1 'Barrios Medellin' (271 urban barrios) and 0 'Comunas Medellin' (16 urban comunas), from the report 'Medellín: memorias de una guerra urbana' (2017), ArcGIS item 1bb9c7b3a8094389ad9b45494d52e398, downloaded 2026-10-31. Names proper-cased with accents restored, adjacent numbered parts (No. 1, #2) merged, simplified to ~20 m, 4-decimal coordinates. A comuna whose name a barrio also carries is '<Name> (Comuna N)'. Then the 10 municipalities as whole-municipality entries (Medellín included, as the fallback for its rural corregimientos, which the CNMH layers do not cover) from DANE MGN 2025 (the outlines of config/metro-bounds/medellin.json), ~20 m. Smallest outline wins at lookup. The Alcaldía de Medellín's own 'Límite Barrio Vereda Catastral' (GeoMedellín) was not reachable (www.medellin.gov.co/servidormapas refuses connections) and its published terms forbid commercialisation/transfer; Who's On First has only 16 Quattroshapes neighbourhood polygons here.
